verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no first-party documentation of an official Svelte language server, VS Code/IDE extension, or type-checking tool (svelte-check), and the only related comment is a community complaint that 'IDE support has been an issue' (svelte-comm-15), which is negative rather than confirming. Since axis clearly applies to a TypeScript-capable UI framework but no supporting evidence is present, verdict is none.
